findings.current: and the young prince, kneeling for some reason.
findings.defect: Calls the kneeling child a prince rather than a king.
findings.rationale: 어린 왕 means “young king,” not “young prince.”
findings.replacement: and the young king, kneeling for some reason.
findings.source: 어째서인지 무릎을 꿇고 있는 어린 왕의 모습도 함께.

findings.current: “I’m sure you have questions, and there’s plenty I’d like to ask you, too. But I’d like to leave all that until after this is over.”
findings.defect: Assigns the things left to ask or say to Jeong, when Jeong is acknowledging what Taekyung wants to ask and say.
findings.rationale: Both 묻고 싶은 말 and 하고 싶은 말 refer to the person Jeong is addressing.
findings.replacement: “I’m sure you have plenty to ask me, and plenty you want to say. But I’d like you to save it until after this is over.”
findings.source: “묻고 싶은 말도, 하고 싶은 말도 많겠지. 하지만 그 일은 모든 것이 끝난 뒤로 미뤄 뒀으면 하오.”

findings.current:
But this wasn’t the time to worry about whether I could handle it.

If I used it, I’d have to swallow the consequences.

I’d have to bear them myself.
findings.defect: Turns the bitter-or-sweet image into a calculation about whether using the Middle Dantian has manageable consequences.
findings.rationale: 쓰고 달고 and 써도 삼켜야 한다 sustain the image of swallowing something bitter; they do not say that using the dantian will cause consequences.
findings.replacement:
But now wasn’t the time to be picky about what was bitter and what was sweet.

Even if it was bitter, I had to swallow it.

I had to bear it myself.
findings.source:
하지만 그럼에도 불구하고, 지금은 쓰고 달고를 가릴 때가 아니었다.

써도 삼켜야 한다.

스스로 감내해야 한다.

findings.current:
“That guy watching from over there—is he on our side?”

Jeong Hogun flinched at the word “watching,” then nodded.
findings.defect: Flattens the pointed, voyeuristic joke to ordinary watching, leaving Jeong’s flinch unmotivated.
findings.rationale: 관음 carries a voyeuristic meaning; Jeong reacts specifically to that choice of word.
findings.replacement:
“That guy over there playing peeping Tom—is he on our side?”

Jeong Hogun flinched at “peeping Tom,” then nodded.
findings.source:
“저기서 관음 중인 저 인간, 아군은 맞냐?”

관음이라는 단어에서 움찔한 정호군이 고개를 끄덕였다.

findings.current: A second rain of arrows came moments later, and dozens of crescent blades flashed toward them.
findings.defect: “Crescent blades” omits that the weapons are polearms.
findings.rationale: 언월도 denotes a crescent-bladed polearm, not merely a blade of that shape.
findings.replacement: A second rain of arrows came moments later, and dozens of crescent-bladed polearms flashed toward them.
findings.source: 약간의 시간 차를 두고 들이닥친 두 번째 화살비를 향해 수십여 개의 언월도(偃月刀)가 번뜩였다.

findings.current: I immediately understood the meaning of those three words he’d taken care to add.
findings.defect: Counts the English phrase “at least” as three words.
findings.rationale: 적어도 has three Korean syllables but translates here as two English words.
findings.replacement: I immediately understood why he’d gone out of his way to add that qualifier.
findings.source: 구태여 앞에 붙인 그 세 글자의 의미를, 나는 즉각 알아차렸다.

summary: The draft preserves the battle’s main sequence, but changes one character’s title, shifts a speaker’s intended subject, and loses two meaningful cues.
